name: check_tool_logs
description: Check recent tool execution logs and workflow execution logs. Use this when a tool or workflow fails to understand what went wrong. Can show tool calls, workflow executions, or both. For workflows, shows which steps completed and any errors.

tool_name.description: Optional: specific tool name to check logs for. If not provided, shows all recent calls.

limit.description: Number of recent log entries to return (default: 3)

log_type.description: Type of logs to check: 'tools' for tool calls (default), 'workflows' for workflow executions, 'all' for both.

workflow_id.description: Optional: filter workflow logs by specific workflow ID (e.g., 'crypto_market_report', 'web_archive').
